Weird Instant-fail lich bug
So after a bit of floundering around(as usual, Scorpions=falling on your face) I've gone after a level 4 lich with a 46% Toxin Kuva Hek.

Only for the game to just...break.

For the last 12 attempts(because good lord does that Toxin damage show exactly how 'balanced' statuses are) I've been getting downed once.

And then Cephalon Cy decides I just don't get to play.

Now admittedly this lich is immune to and/or resistant to every status effect thats actually worth anything, but I'm not incompetent, just stubborn and determined to do this by myself.

But did I miss something, or am I not(per every other lich so far) allowed multiple downs?

Or did they update things and basically turn this into One-hit-wonders when the Lich has a weapon that bypasses most of your defensive options for laughs?
